properties.description: Dispatched when a player asks to join, before the connection exists: they hold no player slot, are not counted as online, and are sent nothing -- no resource list, no download, no body. The request waits until every handler has returned and every Promise a handler returned has settled, then it is let in if a player slot is free (otherwise it is refused as full). `connection.reject()` turns it away instead, and so does a handler that throws or rejects, or handlers that have not settled within the server's admission timeout (30 seconds by default, restarted by every `connection.update()`). functions.description: Reads how far a player's voice carries, with the server-wide default already resolved.
functions.name: getPlayerRange

functions.description: Reads the voice tier a player is on. A player switching tier raises the playerVoiceTierChange event with the player and the new tier.
functions.name: getPlayerTier

functions.description: Reads the server-wide proximity range.
functions.name: getRange

functions.description: Reads how far a voice tier carries, with the server-wide range already resolved.
functions.name: getTierRange

functions.description: Checks a one-way mute.
functions.name: isLocallyMuted

returns.description: True when the listener does not receive the target.

functions.description: Checks the server-wide deafen flag.
functions.name: isPlayerDeaf

returns.description: True when the player receives nobody's voice.

functions.description: Checks the server-wide mute flag.
functions.name: isPlayerMuted

returns.description: True when the player's voice reaches nobody.

functions.description: Checks whether a player is speaking right now. Tracks speech rather than the push-to-talk key: silence is dropped before it reaches the server, and the state clears shortly after the last frame. The same signal raises the playerVoiceStart and playerVoiceStop events.
functions.name: isPlayerTalking

returns.description: True while the player's voice is reaching the server.

functions.description: Checks whether a player left voice chat enabled in their own client settings. A preference, not a permission: use setPlayerMuted or setPlayerDeaf to enforce anything.
functions.name: isPlayerVoiceEnabled

returns.description: True unless the player turned voice chat off.

functions.description: One-way mute between two players, enforced by the server rather than the client.
functions.name: setLocalMute

parameters.description: Player who stops hearing the target.
parameters.name: listener

parameters.description: True to mute, false to restore.
parameters.name: muted

functions.description: Server-wide deafen: a deaf player receives nobody.
functions.name: setPlayerDeaf

parameters.description: True to stop them receiving anyone's voice.
parameters.name: deaf

functions.description: Server-wide mute: a muted player's voice reaches nobody.
functions.name: setPlayerMuted

parameters.description: True to stop their voice reaching anyone.
parameters.name: muted

functions.description: Overrides how far one player's voice carries, whichever voice tier they chose.
functions.name: setPlayerRange

parameters.description: Player whose voice carries the given distance.
parameters.name: player

parameters.description: Audibility radius in world units; values <= 0 return them to the radius of their voice tier.
parameters.name: range

functions.description: Puts a player on a voice tier, as if they had switched to it. Their own indicator follows, and the playerVoiceTierChange event is not raised.
functions.name: setPlayerTier

functions.description: Sets how far voice carries for talkers with no override of their own. Connected clients are told, so their playback fades out at the same distance.
functions.name: setRange

parameters.description: Audibility radius in world units; values <= 0 restore the default of 25.
parameters.name: range

functions.description: Sets how far a voice tier carries. Players switch tier themselves; whisper starts at 3, shout at 25, and normal carries the server-wide range. Set a tier to 0 to make it carry the server-wide range, which takes it away. Connected clients are told.
functions.name: setTierRange

parameters.description: Audibility radius in world units; values <= 0 make the tier carry the server-wide range.
parameters.name: range
